description.description: Description of the query. Max size = 256.

city.description: The name of the city. Max size = 100.

country.description: The name of the country. Max size = 100.

state.description: The name of the state. Max size = 100.

street.description: The name of the street. Max size = 100.

street2.description: The name of the street. Max size = 100.

admin_state.description: The site mode of operation, can be in one of three states: Active - the site is in Control mode and network policy is applied. Monitor - the site is in Analytics mode, no network policy is applied. Disabled: the site is disabled.

element_cluster_role.description: This attribute describes the type i.e. SPOKE or HUB.

priority.description: The priority set for the event.

standing.description: The standing event. True or False.

suppressed.description: The events are suppressed. True or False.

suppressed_info.description: The information on the suppressed events.

root_cause_event_ids.description: The event IDs of the root causes.

suppressed_info.title: SuppressedInfo

timestamp.description: The time stamp of the event.

location.description: The geographical cordinates for the site address.

latitude.description: The latitude of the location. Max range = 90.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location. Max range = 180.

location.title: Location

policy_set_id.description: The ID for the Original Network Policy Set. Can be retrieved using policysets API.

security_policyset_id.description: The ID for the Original Security Policy Set. Can be retrieved using securitypolicysets API.

service_binding.description: Bind a site to a set of domains. Can be retrieved using sericebindingmaps API.
